'''February 2002 Littlehampton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Littlehampton, England on 24 February 2002. [[Matt Hardy]] won it. It is known from Chris Seymour's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3400">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-25-littlehampton-24-2-02-sealed-deckd3400/ littlehampton-24-2-02-sealed-deck], DeckTech (Chris "vader69" Seymour, 25 February 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-25-littlehampton-24-2-02-sealed-deckd3400/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 February 2002
* '''Site:''' Littlehampton, England
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 9
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Hardy]]

== Tournament reports ==

Players' own reports from this event.

* [[Chris Seymour Littlehampton 24-2-02 Sealed Deck (tournament report)]] — by [[Chris Seymour]], 4th, 2–3
* [[Elliott Weights Littlehampton 24-02-02 (tournament report)]] — by [[Elliott Weights]], 3rd, 4–2

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Elliott Weights lists 6th Jacob Keet, 7th Ed Bentley and 8th Michael Bentley; Chris Seymour's report (the hub's source) has 6th Edward Bentley, 7th Michael Bentley and 8th Jacob Keet.<ref name="tr-d3443">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-07-littlehampton-24-02-02d3443/ littlehampton-24-02-02], DeckTech (Elliott "Dengar 69" Weights, 7 March 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-07-littlehampton-24-02-02d3443/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
* Weights gives Chris Seymour 6 (+16), 'winning the last three'; Seymour's own report gives 6 (+13) with two wins and a round-5 bye.<ref name="tr-d3443" />
